payload.core_mechanism_summary: Linear scan over the given words, using flags to check for exact match or existence of words providing required prefix/suffix characters.
payload.rationale: The solution performs a simple linear check over all input words (complete search over the list), setting flags when conditions are met. It does not use recursion, backtracking, or any combinatorial enumeration. None of the candidate subtypes accurately describe this; search_backtracking is the rule_top_subtype despite no backtracking.
